source_pdf: Geological_Map_of_Nigeria.pdf (image-based local source; geometry was recovered from the visually matched vector edition)
method: Axis-aligned page-to-coordinate fit from the map's printed 1-degree graticule. The map's embedded metadata was not used. The fixed Nigeria Admin-0 polygon and named city positions were independent checks; the generalized polygon was not used to override the tighter graticule fit.

state_boundary_network_to_reference_boun.note: Coarse QA only: the source network contains internal state boundaries as well as the national outline.

capital_label_controls.note: Capital labels/marker centers are approximate map positions and were used as a cross-check, not as a stronger fit than the printed graticule.

source_match.render_comparison: 72-dpi pages align at (0,0); RGB mean absolute error approximately [5.03, 4.76, 4.59] on 0-255 scale. The extracted unit geometry matches the public vector edition.

limitations: The 117 m value is the graticule-fit residual, not a claim of survey-grade positional accuracy.
The map scale, rasterization, and generalized Nigeria reference polygon limit positional precision.
The reference outline is used only for georeferencing QA; geology units were not clipped to it.
